claims.statement: For a declared total adapter alpha:Y->X and valid sets G_T,G_S, transfer of every rejection set D subset X\G_S preserves all G_T candidates iff alpha(G_T) subset G_S. Necessity takes D=X\G_S; sufficiency is immediate by exclusion. Pullbacks compose only with valid domain/adapter premises.
dependencies: The original/target valid sets and adapter are supplied, well-defined and independently justified.
Safe rejection does not supply a valid action policy, preserve every solution route or preserve total cost.
